candidates.draft_title: Add bulk reassignment of members to a new coach when a coach departs
candidates.snippet:
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: One thing's been a genuine pain, and it's not a bug exactly, it's more of a missing capability. Let me explain the situation.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: So we had a coach leave the platform last month. One of the coaches assigned to a bunch of our people just... left. Retired, moved on, I don't know the details on your side.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: That's the problem. Forty-three. Forty-three of our nurses and staff were all matched to this one coach.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Right. So the coach leaves, and now I've got forty-three people who need to be moved to a new coach. And the only way I could find to do it was one. At. A. Time.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: One at a time. Go into each member, find the reassignment option, pick a new coach, confirm, next member. Forty-three times. I did it over two afternoons and I wanted to throw my monitor out the window.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: And the whole time I'm thinking, surely there's a bulk option. Surely I can select all the members who were with Coach A and reassign them to Coach B in one move. But I couldn't find one. If it exists, I failed to find it, and I looked hard.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Well, that's validating and infuriating in equal measure.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Simple version: when a coach leaves — or even just when I want to rebalance — I want to see all the members currently assigned to that coach, select them, and reassign the whole group to a new coach in one action. Bulk reassign.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Exactly that. And the departing-coach case is the one that really stings because it's forced, it's urgent, and it's high-volume all at once. Those people are suddenly coachless and I'm scrambling.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Yes. In our world, a nurse who's stressed and suddenly has no coach for a week because I'm clicking through forty-three profiles — that's a real gap.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Use all of it. If it saves the next admin from my monitor-throwing rage, worth it.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Departing coach is the burning one. Rebalancing would be nice-to-have but I can live without it. If I had to pick, solve the coach-leaves case.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Perfect. I feel heard, which is more than I expected from an admin sync.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Noted. I'll save my rage for the syncs.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Onboarding's fine. I pull the roster export monthly for our HRIS reconciliation and that's been smooth since the CSV export got added. That one made my life better, so credit where due.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: That's the one. Everything else is boringly functional, which is what I want from software.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Good question. The history stayed intact, as far as I could tell. Each member kept their record, it just pointed at a new coach. So the data was fine, it was purely the tedium of doing it forty-three times.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Correct. The one-at-a-time reassign works perfectly. There's just no way to do it in bulk. That's the entire ask.
[EXTERNAL] Harold Nguyen: Exactly. Don't touch the thing that works, just let me do it a hundred at a time.
